g.title: JACK
g.text: Plug the TalentCell 12.6 V charger here.

g.title: W_CHG
g.text: ends in a 5.5x2.1 plug into the battery DC input

g.title: BAT
g.text: 3S Li-ion 11.1 V 6 Ah, 36 W max (base cradle)
OUT = 5.5x2.1 DC output, IN = charger DC input. Own BMS + charger.

g.title: SW
g.text: main power, base wall, SPST min. 3 A

g.title: W_SERVO
g.text: turret, via the ribbon clock spring (D-19)

g.title: ESP32
g.text: GPIO34 is input-only (no pull-up). GPIO2/5/15 are strapping pins; wiring keeps their boot levels safe.

g.title: TMC_TURN
g.text: VREF ~1.13 V for 0.8 A RMS (module with 0.11 R sense). PDN/UART left open.

g.title: W_COIL_TURN
g.text: check coil pairs with a meter; swap one pair to reverse direction

g.title: TMC_RACK
g.text: VREF ~1.13 V for 0.8 A RMS (module with 0.11 R sense). PDN/UART left open.

g.title: W_COIL_RACK
g.text: turret, via the ribbon clock spring (D-19)

g.title: DRV
g.text: Ch A = loader N20 (IN1/IN2). Ch B = launcher, BIN1 = IN3 (PWM), BIN2 = IN4 tied to GND.

g.title: W_N20
g.text: turret, via the ribbon clock spring (D-19)

g.title: W_130
g.text: turret, via the ribbon clock spring (D-19)

g.title: IRRX_EXIT
g.text: launcher entry, turret (open collector, VCC 5 V)

g.title: HALL
g.text: turret home, base deck (magnet in turntable at 0 deg)
Needs 4.5 V min, so VCC = 5 V. Open-collector OUT, pulled up to 3V3 only.

g.title: DIV
g.text: TOP = switched +12V, MID = ADC node, BOT = GND. 12.6 V to 2.27 V at GPIO34.
